title: Freezing as a structuring process for protein gels: process–structure relationship, material characterization, and comparison with meats
content:
Sustainable Food Technol., 2026, 4,2697-2708
DOI: 10.1039/D5FB00871A, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Israel Jovino Caneschi, Daniel Angelo Longhi, Charles Windson Isidoro Haminiuk, Maria Lucia Masson
Structured SPI gels with meat-like texture and colour were obtained by freeze structuring. Solids content and pH were key determinants, with 9% solids, pH 5.5 and −10 °C representing the most promising conditions.
